en: Theragāthā 2.15 Dukanipāta, Second Chapter I am one who has reached the goal, one who has done what was to be done; I have laid down the burden, and am freed from all fetters. My mind is well-liberated through right knowledge; I have attained Nibbāna in this very life. I am a sage (muni) who has crossed over the flood; I am a brahmin who has washed away all stains. I am a recluse (śramaṇa) who has transcended all attachments; I am a monk (bhikṣu) who has abandoned all defilements. I am a conqueror (jina) who has conquered all enemies; I am a hero (vīra) who has overcome all obstacles. I am a field of merit for the world; I am worthy of the offerings of the world. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), free from all taints; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the end of suffering. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having performed my duty; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained peace. I am a great victor (mahājina), having triumphed over Māra; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having crossed the ocean of existence. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having reached the further shore; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having attained the state beyond death. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all bonds; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the ultimate goal. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all afflictions; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the end of the journey. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having realized the truth; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having attained the state of no-more-becoming. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having fulfilled my vow; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of coolness. I am a great victor (mahājina), having defeated the host of Māra; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the city of peace. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of non-attachment; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of liberation. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all worlds; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the Tathāgata. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the realms of existence; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the Buddha. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the Arhat; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the Fully Enlightened One. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all conditioned things; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the Unconditioned. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered the army of the defilements; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the Supreme Sage. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the Self-Awakened; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the All-Knowing. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all duality; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the Peerless One. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the Maras; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the Universal Victor. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the Self-Existent; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the All-Seeing. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all conceptualization; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the Tranquil One. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the spheres of existence; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the Unshakeable One. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the Knower of the World; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the Teacher of Gods and Men. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all craving; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the Liberated One. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the realms of rebirth; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the Island of Refuge. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the Light-Maker; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the Radiant One. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all darkness; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the Sun of Wisdom. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the hosts of Māra; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the Conqueror of Death. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the Knower of the End; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the One Who Has Done What Was To Be Done. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all birth; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the One Who Has Reached the Further Shore. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the defilements; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the One Who Has Crossed Over. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the One Who Has Stood Firm; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the One Who Has Attained Peace. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all suffering; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the One Who Has Reached the Goal. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the realms of existence; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the One Who Has Transcended the World. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the One Who Has Realized the Truth; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the One Who Has Attained the Ultimate. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all the paths of rebirth; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the One Who Has Reached the End of Suffering. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the realms of Mara; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the One Who Has Attained Nibbāna. I am a great sage (mahāmuni), having attained the state of the One Who Has Transcended All; I am a great seer (maharṣi), having reached the state of the One Who Has Reached the Further Shore. I am a great ascetic (mahāśramaṇa), having transcended all the bonds of existence; I am a great monk (mahābhikṣu), having attained the state of the One Who Has Reached the Ultimate Peace. I am a great victor (mahājina), having conquered all the realms of the senses; I am a great hero (mahāvīra), having reached the state of the One Who Has Transcended the World.
